retainedFollowUps.title: Implement script toggle (繁體/簡體 content switching)
files: src/content/ (structured entries with zh-Hant + zh-Hans fields)
tests: tests/script-toggle.test.ts (new — toggle render, preference persistence, lang attribute sync)
retainedFollowUps.startCondition: Product owner activates script toggle feature
retainedFollowUps.stopCondition: Toggle switches all Chinese content between Traditional (zh-Hant) and Simplified (zh-Hans) characters; structured content entries have separate zh-Hant and zh-Hans fields; render layer reads the active script preference and selects the correct field; preference persisted in localStorage; tests cover all states
retainedFollowUps.benefit: Single-script learners can read content in their preferred script without separate routes; structured schema supports both script variants for future content
